mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_detail, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ref, a.created_at, a.updated_at
FROM education_achievements a JOIN course_operation_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'COURSE_OPERATION' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a, d

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE >= m.effective_start_date AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= m.effective_end_date) ORDER BY m.mapping_id LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s WHERE s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.item_code = 'COURSE_OPERATION' AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_part != 'NONE' AND s.evaluation_confirmed_yn = 'N' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN s.effective_start_date AND s.effective_end_date AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.organization_code = s.target_scope )
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT s.management_item_code, s.management_item_name, s.evaluation_year, s.teacher_editable_part
ORDER BY s.evaluation_year DESC, s.management_item_code

SELECT COUNT(*)
AND s.management_item_code = #{code} AND s.evaluation_year = #{year}
SELECT f.finalization_id FROM evaluation_finalizations f WHERE f.target_user_id = #{userId} AND f.evaluation_year = #{year} AND f.final_status = 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{code}, achievement_date = #{date}, attachment_ref = #{attachments,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, request_id = #{requestId}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'COURSE_OPERATION' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('COURSE_OPERATION', #{id}, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', #{actor}, #{requestId})
